newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Diana plans Bosnia land mine trip-report.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Diana plans Bosnia land mine trip-report.

text.p: Britain's Princess Diana is to visit Bosnia this week to campaign against land mines, the Express newspaper said on Tuesday.
The visit, starting on Friday and lasting three to four days, has received official approval, said the paper, quoting unnamed Foreign Office sources.
Princess Diana's trip on behalf of the Red Cross is also believed to have the blessing of Prime Minister Tony Blair, it said.
Her visit will mirror her previous trips to Africa, including visits to mine victims and seeing mine clearing in the former war zone, said the report.
The princess' campaign against the use of land mines has sparked controversy in Britain, forcing her to abandon plans to attend a meeting in the Houses of Parliament on the issue earlier this year.
